verdict.rationale: Private, member-restricted sub-teams are a fair question for a project-management tool like Shortcut, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents creating private teams or sub-teams limited to specific members. The closest item is creating additional Workspaces to protect sensitive information, which is workspace-level separation, not a private sub-team. Mentions of aligning teams do not cover access restriction.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create private sub-teams restricted to specific members
